sql: SELECT "rq"."question_id", "rq"."question_text", "s"."submitter_name", NVL("s"."email", 'no-email@unknown.com') AS "contact_email" FROM "research_questions" "rq" JOIN "submitters" "s" ON "rq"."submitter_id" = "s"."submitter_id" WHERE "rq"."is_approved" = 1

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "rq"."submission_date") AS "submission_month", "s"."submitter_name", NVL("rq"."revised_question_id", 0) AS "revision_indicator", COUNT(*) AS "question_count" FROM "research_questions" "rq" INNER JOIN "submitters" "s" ON "rq"."submitter_id" = "s"."submitter_id" WHERE "rq"."final_score" = 0 AND "rq"."status" IN ('pending_review', 'approved') GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "rq"."submission_date"), "s"."submitter_name", NVL("rq"."revised_question_id", 0) ORDER BY "submission_month", "question_count" DESC

SELECT zone_name, data_source, avg_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY zone_name ORDER BY avg_value DESC) AS `rank` FROM (SELECT cz.zone_name, ad.data_source, AVG(ad.value) AS avg_value FROM agricultural_data ad INNER JOIN climate_zones cz ON ad.zone_id = cz.zone_id GROUP BY cz.zone_name, ad.data_source) AS sub WHERE avg_value > 100

SELECT pm.project_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('"', u.user_name, '": "', u.email, '"') SEPARATOR ', ') AS json_users, LENGTH(u.user_name) AS name_bytes FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE pm.project_id IN (SELECT p.project_id FROM research_projects p WHERE LENGTH(p.project_name) - LENGTH(REPLACE(LOWER(p.project_name), 'a', '')) > 2) GROUP BY pm.project_id, u.user_name ORDER BY pm.project_id, name_bytes DESC
SELECT county_name, average_temperature, average_rainfall, elevation FROM counties WHERE soil_type = 'Loam' ORDER BY elevation ASC

SELECT c.county_name, c.average_rainfall, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM y.harvest_date::date) AS harvest_year FROM counties c INNER JOIN yields y ON c.county_id = y.county_id WHERE c.average_rainfall > 900 AND y.harvest_date::date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY harvest_year DESC

SELECT * FROM (SELECT "e"."endpoint_id", "e"."uri", "v"."version_number", SUM("eu"."access_count") AS "total_access", ROUND(AVG("eu"."response_time"), 2) AS "avg_response", MOD(SUM("eu"."access_count"), 2) AS "access_parity" FROM "api_endpoints" "e" INNER JOIN "api_versions" "v" ON "e"."version_id" = "v"."version_id" INNER JOIN "endpoint_usage" "eu" ON "e"."endpoint_id" = "eu"."endpoint_id" GROUP BY "e"."endpoint_id", "e"."uri", "v"."version_number" ORDER BY "total_access" DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

WITH "usage_stats" AS (
  SELECT 
    "eu"."endpoint_id",
    "ae"."uri",
    "ae"."http_method",
    TO_CHAR("eu"."access_date", 'MONTH') AS "access_month",
    TO_CHAR("eu"."access_date", 'YYYY-MM') AS "month_key",
    SUM("eu"."access_count") AS "total_access",
    TRUNC(AVG("eu"."response_time"), 6) AS "avg_response",
    PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "eu"."access_count") AS "median_access",
    GREATEST(SUM("eu"."error_count"), NULL, 5) AS "error_tolerance"
  FROM "endpoint_usage" "eu"
  INNER JOIN "api_endpoints" "ae" ON "eu"."endpoint_id" = "ae"."endpoint_id"
  WHERE "eu"."access_date" >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -6)
  GROUP BY "eu"."endpoint_id", "ae"."uri", "ae"."http_method", TO_CHAR("eu"."access_date", 'MONTH'), TO_CHAR("eu"."access_date", 'YYYY-MM')
),
"ranked_stats" AS (
  SELECT 
    "us".*, 
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "us"."month_key" ORDER BY "us"."total_access" DESC) AS "month_rank",
    CASE 
      WHEN "us"."avg_response" < (SELECT AVG("eu2"."response_time") FROM "endpoint_usage" "eu2" WHERE "eu2"."endpoint_id" = "us"."endpoint_id") 
      THEN 'fast'
      ELSE 'slow'
    END AS "performance_tier",
    NULL AS "rank_letter"
  FROM "usage_stats" "us"
)
SELECT 
  "rs"."access_month",
  "rs"."uri",
  "rs"."http_method",
  "rs"."total_access",
  "rs"."avg_response",
  "rs"."median_access",
  "rs"."error_tolerance",
  "rs"."month_rank",
  "rs"."performance_tier",
  CHR(65 + "rs"."month_rank") AS "rank_letter"
FROM "ranked_stats" "rs"
WHERE "rs"."month_rank" <= 3
ORDER BY "rs"."month_key" DESC, "rs"."total_access" DESC
FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "cnt", AVG(NVL("industry_standard", 0)) AS "avg_std" FROM "sizes" WHERE "industry_standard" = 1

SELECT "c"."first_name" || ' ' || "c"."last_name" AS full_name, "c"."preferred_size_category", LISTAGG("cm"."cuff_circumference", ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "cm"."cuff_circumference") AS cuff_list FROM "customers" "c" LEFT JOIN "customer_measurements" "cm" ON "c"."customer_id" = "cm"."customer_id" WHERE "c"."gender" = 'Women' GROUP BY "c"."first_name", "c"."last_name", "c"."preferred_size_category" ORDER BY full_name

SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.category) p.category, p.product_name, CAST(p.price AS MONEY) AS price_as_money, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'FMSS') AS seconds_today FROM products p INNER JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id INNER JOIN sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id ORDER BY p.category, s.sale_date DESC NULLS LAST

WITH sales_summary AS (
  SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category,
         SUM(s.quantity) AS total_sold,
         AVG(SUM(s.quantity)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.quantity) DESC
           RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP) AS running_avg
  FROM sales s
  INNER JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category
),
product_rank AS (
  SELECT ss.*,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sold DESC) AS rank
  FROM sales_summary ss
)
SELECT pr.rank, pr.product_name, pr.category, pr.total_sold,
       CAST(pr.total_sold AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS sold_decimal,
       TO_CHAR(pr.running_avg, 'FM99.00') AS avg_format
FROM product_rank pr
WHERE pr.rank <= 5
ORDER BY pr.rank
SELECT product_name, TO_CHAR(price, '999.99') AS formatted_price, COALESCE(description, 'No description') AS product_description FROM products ORDER BY product_name

SELECT TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS creation_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(p.price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_price, COALESCE(AVG(s.outseam), 0) AS avg_outseam FROM products p INNER JOIN sizes s ON p.size_id = s.size_id INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.gender IN ('Male', 'Unisex') GROUP BY creation_month HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) >= 1 ORDER BY creation_month

SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.problem_id) p.problem_id, p.description, CONCAT(u.user_name, ' ', u.email) AS contact_info, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.applied_at IS NOT NULL) AS remediations_applied, COUNT(*) AS total_remediations FROM problems p INNER JOIN users u ON p.resolved_by = u.user_id INNER JOIN remediations r ON p.problem_id = r.problem_id GROUP BY p.problem_id, p.description, u.user_name, u.email, r.created_at ORDER BY p.problem_id, r.created_at DESC

WITH assembly_stats AS (  SELECT a.assembly_id, a.assembly_name, a.created_at,          LOG(COALESCE(p.problem_count, 1)) AS log_problems,          GREATEST(CAST(SPLIT_PART(a.expected_version, '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / NULLIF(av.version_count, 0), CAST(SPLIT_PART(a.actual_version, '.', 1) AS INTEGER), NULL) AS effective_version_ratio,          TO_CHAR(a.created_at, 'Day, DD Month YYYY HH12:MI AM') AS creation_date   FROM assemblies a   LEFT JOIN (SELECT assembly_id, COUNT(*) AS problem_count FROM problems GROUP BY assembly_id) p ON a.assembly_id = p.assembly_id   LEFT JOIN (SELECT assembly_id, COUNT(*) AS version_count, MAX(version_number) AS latest_version FROM assembly_versions GROUP BY assembly_id) av ON a.assembly_id = av.assembly_id), ranked_assemblies AS (  SELECT assembly_name, log_problems, effective_version_ratio, creation_date,          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY log_problems DESC) AS rank   FROM assembly_stats) SELECT assembly_name, log_problems, COALESCE(effective_version_ratio, 0) AS version_ratio, creation_date FROM ranked_assemblies WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY log_problems DESC
SELECT sale_id, DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%W') AS weekday_name FROM sales WHERE YEAR(sale_date) = 2024

SELECT d.dealer_name, IFNULL(COUNT(di.incentive_id), 0) AS incentive_count FROM dealers d LEFT JOIN dealer_incentives di ON d.dealer_id = di.dealer_id GROUP BY d.dealer_name ORDER BY incentive_count DESC

SELECT t.track_name, ts.session_type, ts.session_date, df.file_path, SUBSTRING_INDEX(df.file_path, '/', -1) AS file_name, LOCATE('.', df.file_path) AS dot_pos, CASE WHEN df.file_path LIKE CONCAT('%', '.', '%') THEN 'binary' ELSE 'text' END AS file_category FROM test_tracks t INNER JOIN test_sessions ts ON t.track_id = ts.track_id INNER JOIN sessions_files sf ON ts.session_id = sf.session_id INNER JOIN data_files df ON sf.file_id = df.file_id INNER JOIN (SELECT session_id FROM test_sessions WHERE session_duration > 60 ORDER BY number_of_laps DESC LIMIT 3) AS limited_sessions ON ts.session_id = limited_sessions.session_id ORDER BY ts.number_of_laps DESC

WITH session_stats AS (SELECT s.session_id, v.vehicle_name, s.session_duration, s.number_of_laps, s.session_date, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(s.session_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%W, %M %d, %Y') AS formatted_date, IFNULL(s.number_of_laps, 0) AS laps_filled, RAND(12345) AS random_factor FROM test_sessions s INNER JOIN vehicles v ON s.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE s.session_duration > 0), efficiency AS (SELECT session_id, vehicle_name, formatted_date, session_duration, laps_filled, IF(laps_filled > 0, laps_filled / session_duration * 60, 0) AS laps_per_hour, random_factor FROM session_stats WHERE formatted_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT vehicle_name, formatted_date, session_duration, laps_filled, laps_per_hour, random_factor FROM efficiency ORDER BY IFNULL(laps_per_hour, 999999) DESC, formatted_date ASC
SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS full_name, email FROM users WHERE role = 'Pilot' ORDER BY last_name LIMIT 5

SELECT fl.log_id, fl.event_type, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(fl.event_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS formatted_time, u.first_name FROM flight_logs fl INNER JOIN users u ON fl.user_id = u.user_id WHERE fl.event_type = 'departure'

SELECT "t"."team_name",        ORA_HASH("t"."team_name", 3) AS "hash_bucket",        DECODE(ORA_HASH("t"."team_name", 3), 0, 'Group A', 1, 'Group B', 2, 'Group C', 'Group D') AS "team_group",        ROUND("s"."win_percentage", 3) AS "win_pct_rounded" FROM "teams" "t" INNER JOIN "standings" "s" ON "t"."team_id" = "s"."team_id" WHERE "t"."founded_year" > 1890 ORDER BY "win_pct_rounded" DESC

WITH division_stats AS (SELECT d."division_id", d."division_name", COUNT(t."team_id") AS team_count, SUM(s."win") AS total_wins, SUM(s."loss") AS total_losses, TRUNC(AVG(s."runs_scored"), 0) AS avg_runs_scored, TRUNC(AVG(s."runs_allowed"), 0) AS avg_runs_allowed FROM "divisions" d INNER JOIN "teams" t ON d."division_id" = t."division_id" INNER JOIN "standings" s ON t."team_id" = s."team_id" GROUP BY d."division_id", d."division_name"), ranked_divisions AS (SELECT ds."division_name", ds.team_count, ds.total_wins, ds.total_losses, ds.avg_runs_scored, ds.avg_runs_allowed, GREATEST(ds.total_wins - ds.total_losses, ds.avg_runs_scored - ds.avg_runs_allowed, 0) AS performance_margin, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.total_wins DESC, ds.total_losses ASC) AS division_rank, NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_runs_scored DESC) AS scoring_tier FROM division_stats ds) SELECT rd."division_name", rd.division_rank, rd.scoring_tier, rd.total_wins, rd.total_losses, rd.avg_runs_scored, rd.avg_runs_allowed, rd.performance_margin, CASE WHEN rd.scoring_tier = 1 THEN 'High Scoring' WHEN rd.scoring_tier = 2 THEN 'Mid Scoring' ELSE 'Low Scoring' END AS scoring_category, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS analysis_timestamp FROM ranked_divisions rd ORDER BY rd.division_rank
SELECT player_name, IFNULL(player_salary, 0) AS salary_amount FROM players WHERE team_id = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(g.game_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%W') AS game_weekday, t.team_name AS home_team, g.attendance FROM games g INNER JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE g.attendance > 18500 ORDER BY game_weekday

SELECT "t"."trip_id",        TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP("t"."starttime", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "start_time_fmt",        POWER("t"."cost", 2) AS "cost_squared" FROM "trips" "t" INNER JOIN "stations" "s" ON "t"."start_station_id" = "s"."station_id" WHERE "s"."station_id" IN (SELECT "station_id" FROM "stations" WHERE "capacity" > 15)

SELECT "b"."bike_model", NVL(AVG("t"."cost"), 0) AS "avg_cost", LISTAGG("s"."station_name", ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "s"."station_name") AS "stations_used" FROM "trips" "t" INNER JOIN "bikes" "b" ON "t"."bike_id" = "b"."bike_id" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "station_id", "station_name" FROM "stations") "s" ON "t"."start_station_id" = "s"."station_id" WHERE "t"."cost" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "b"."bike_id", "b"."bike_model" ORDER BY "avg_cost" DESC

WITH hourly_rentals AS (SELECT r."rental_id", r."dteday", r."hr", r."cnt", r."season", r."weathersit", TO_CHAR(r."dteday", 'Day, Month DD, YYYY') AS "formatted_date", TO_CHAR(r."dteday", 'YYYY-MM') AS "rental_month", GREATEST(r."cnt", 0) AS "adjusted_cnt", NVL(r."cnt" / NULLIF(r."cnt", 0), 0) AS "self_ratio" FROM "rentals" r), ranked_rentals AS (SELECT hr."rental_month", hr."hr", hr."formatted_date", hr."adjusted_cnt", hr."self_ratio", s."season_name", ws."weather_situation_name", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hr."rental_month" ORDER BY hr."adjusted_cnt" DESC) AS "monthly_rank" FROM hourly_rentals hr LEFT JOIN "seasons" s ON hr."season" = s."season_id" LEFT JOIN "weather_situation" ws ON hr."weathersit" = ws."weather_situation_id") SELECT rr."rental_month", rr."hr", rr."weather_situation_name", LISTAGG(rr."formatted_date", '; ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rr."monthly_rank") AS "top_dates", MAX(rr."adjusted_cnt") AS "peak_rentals", REGEXP_REPLACE(rr."weather_situation_name", '([A-Z])', '<\1>') AS "cleaned_weather" FROM ranked_rentals rr WHERE rr."monthly_rank" <= 3 GROUP BY rr."rental_month", rr."hr", rr."weather_situation_name" ORDER BY rr."rental_month", MIN(rr."monthly_rank")
SELECT "station_name", "current_bikes_count" FROM (SELECT "station_name", "current_bikes_count" FROM "stations" WHERE "capacity" >= 40 ORDER BY "current_bikes_count" DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT l.lab_id, l.lab_name, AVG(ts.transfection_efficiency) AS avg_efficiency, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(ts.transfection_date), '%c/%Y') AS earliest_study_month, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ts.transfection_efficiency) DESC) AS `rank` FROM laboratories l INNER JOIN transfection_studies ts ON l.lab_id = ts.lab_id GROUP BY l.lab_id, l.lab_name HAVING COUNT(ts.study_id) >= 2 ORDER BY avg_efficiency DESC

WITH efficiency_stats AS (  SELECT ct.cell_name,          ts.transfection_efficiency,          LOG(ts.transfection_efficiency) AS log_eff,          GREATEST(ts.transfection_efficiency, (SELECT AVG(ts2.transfection_efficiency) FROM transfection_studies ts2 WHERE ts2.cell_id = ts.cell_id), NULL) AS adj_eff,          CASE WHEN ts.particle_size > 0 THEN ts.zeta_potential / ts.particle_size ELSE NULL END AS zeta_ratio,          DATE_FORMAT(ts.transfection_date, '%Y-%c') AS eff_month   FROM transfection_studies ts   INNER JOIN cell_types ct ON ts.cell_id = ct.cell_id), ranked AS (  SELECT es.*,          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY es.eff_month ORDER BY es.transfection_efficiency DESC) AS month_rank,          IF(es.transfection_efficiency > 0.5, 'high', 'low') AS eff_category   FROM efficiency_stats es) SELECT cell_name, eff_month,        AVG(log_eff) AS avg_log_eff,        SUM(adj_eff) / COUNT(adj_eff) AS avg_adj_eff,        AVG(zeta_ratio) * 100 AS avg_zeta_ratio_pct,        SUM(IF(eff_category = 'high', 1, 0)) AS high_eff_count FROM ranked WHERE month_rank <= 2 GROUP BY cell_name, eff_month ORDER BY avg_log_eff DESC
SELECT genus || ' ' || species_name AS scientific_name, conservation_status FROM species WHERE conservation_status = 'Vulnerable' ORDER BY species_name

SELECT u.user_name, CASE WHEN u.role = 'data_curator' THEN 'Curator' ELSE 'Other' END AS role_category, STRING_AGG(d.dataset_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.dataset_name) AS datasets_created FROM users u LEFT JOIN datasets d ON u.user_id = d.created_by GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role ORDER BY u.user_name

SELECT "cl"."cell_line_name", "p"."patient_name" || ' - ' || "to"."outcome" AS "info", (TO_DATE("cl"."authentication_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') - DATE '1970-01-01') * 86400 AS "unix_time" FROM "cell_lines" "cl" LEFT JOIN "treatment_outcomes" "to" ON 1=0 LEFT JOIN "patients" "p" ON "to"."patient_id" = "p"."patient_id" WHERE "cl"."passage_number" BETWEEN 10 AND 30

WITH "passage_stats" AS (
  SELECT "cl"."cell_line_id",
         "cl"."cell_line_name",
         "cl"."passage_number",
         "cl"."authentication_date",
         GREATEST("cl"."passage_number", NULL, 10) AS "effective_passage",
         LEAST("cl"."passage_number", 50) AS "capped_passage"
  FROM "cell_lines" "cl"
  WHERE "cl"."hmsl_id" BETWEEN 1000 AND 16777215
),
"ranked_passage" AS (
  SELECT "ps"."cell_line_id",
         "ps"."cell_line_name",
         "ps"."passage_number",
         "ps"."effective_passage",
         "ps"."capped_passage",
         CONCAT('Cell Line: ', "ps"."cell_line_name") AS "concat_name",
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "ps"."passage_number" DESC) AS "passage_rank"
  FROM "passage_stats" "ps"
),
"subtype_counts" AS (
  SELECT "cl2"."clin_subtype_id",
         COUNT(*) AS "subtype_count"
  FROM "cell_lines" "cl2"
  GROUP BY "cl2"."clin_subtype_id"
)
SELECT "rp"."cell_line_name",
       "rp"."passage_number",
       "rp"."effective_passage",
       "rp"."capped_passage",
       "rp"."concat_name",
       "rp"."passage_rank",
       NVL("sc"."subtype_count", 0) AS "subtype_total"
FROM "ranked_passage" "rp"
LEFT JOIN "subtype_counts" "sc" ON "rp"."cell_line_id" = "sc"."clin_subtype_id"
WHERE "rp"."passage_rank" <= 3
ORDER BY "rp"."passage_rank"
SELECT diagnosis_id, TO_CHAR(diagnosis_date, 'FMMM') AS month_num, diagnosis_result FROM diagnoses WHERE diagnosis_confidence >= 0.9

SELECT p.name, p.age, STRING_AGG(d.diagnosis_result, ', ' ORDER BY d.diagnosis_date) AS diagnoses FROM patients p INNER JOIN diagnoses d ON p.patient_id = d.patient_id WHERE p.age > 50 GROUP BY p.patient_id, p.name, p.age ORDER BY p.age

SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.study_id) s.study_id, st.cancer_type, st.study_name, s.age / 1 AS age_years, c.analysis_date FROM studies st INNER JOIN samples s ON st.study_id = s.study_id INNER JOIN cna_data c ON s.sample_id = c.sample_id ORDER BY s.study_id, s.age DESC, c.analysis_date ASC

WITH study_analysis AS (SELECT s.study_id, s.study_name, s.start_date, s.end_date, EXTRACT(DAY FROM COALESCE(s.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) - s.start_date) AS days_active, LOG(COALESCE(r.file_size, 1)) AS log_file_size, GREATEST(s.start_date, (SELECT MAX(s2.start_date) FROM studies s2 WHERE s2.institution = s.institution), NULL) AS max_start_by_inst, (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(COALESCE(s.end_date, CURRENT_DATE), s.start_date)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(COALESCE(s.end_date, CURRENT_DATE), s.start_date))) / 12 AS years_active FROM studies s LEFT JOIN raw_data_files r ON s.study_id = r.study_id) SELECT study_name, days_active, ROUND(log_file_size::numeric, 4) AS rounded_log_size, max_start_by_inst, years_active, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_active DESC) AS activity_rank FROM study_analysis WHERE days_active > 0 ORDER BY activity_rank
SELECT player_name || ' (' || email || ')' AS player_info FROM players WHERE active = true AND email ILIKE '%@example.com'

SELECT r.race_name, STRING_AGG(c.char_name, ', ' ORDER BY c.char_name) AS characters_list FROM races r INNER JOIN characters c ON r.race_id = c.race_id GROUP BY r.race_id, r.race_name ORDER BY r.race_name

SELECT ft.type_name, f.name, DATE_FORMAT(f.last_updated, '%W, %M %d, %Y') AS formatted_update, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ft.type_id ORDER BY f.last_updated DESC) AS rn, DATE_ADD(f.last_updated, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE_SECOND) AS updated_plus_1minsec FROM facility_types ft INNER JOIN facilities f ON ft.type_id = f.type_id

WITH facility_cte AS (SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.state, ft.type_name, DATE_FORMAT(f.last_updated, '%W, %M %d, %Y %h:%i %p') AS formatted_update, LENGTH(f.contact_name) AS name_length, IF(f.wheelchair_access LIKE '%Full%', 'fully_accessible', IF(f.wheelchair_access LIKE '%Partial%', 'partially_accessible', 'unknown')) AS access_category FROM facilities f INNER JOIN facility_types ft ON f.type_id = ft.type_id), ranked AS (SELECT fc.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fc.state ORDER BY fc.formatted_update DESC) AS update_rank, LENGTH(fc.name) - fc.name_length AS name_diff FROM facility_cte fc) SELECT state, access_category, COUNT(*) AS facility_count, GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY name SEPARATOR ', ') AS facility_list FROM ranked WHERE update_rank <= 3 GROUP BY state, access_category ORDER BY state, facility_count DESC
SELECT alert_id, COALESCE(threshold, 0) AS effective_threshold, notification_method, notification_recipient FROM alerts WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY threshold ASC

SELECT f.category, COALESCE(f.factor_description, 'N/A') AS description, STRING_AGG(f.factor_description, '; ' ORDER BY f.factor_id) AS all_descriptions FROM crime_factors f GROUP BY f.category, f.factor_id, description ORDER BY f.category

SELECT token_id, velocity::INTEGER AS velocity_int, rank FROM (SELECT tv.token_id, tv.velocity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tv.velocity DESC) AS rank FROM token_velocities tv WHERE tv.time_interval = '24h') sub WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY rank

WITH provider_stats AS (  SELECT tl.liquidity_provider,          tl.token_id,          tl.total_liquidity,          tl.reserve0,          tl.reserve1,          LOG(tl.total_liquidity) AS log_liquidity,          GREATEST(tl.total_liquidity, (SELECT AVG(tl2.total_liquidity) FROM token_liquidity tl2 WHERE tl2.token_id = tl.token_id), NULL) AS effective_liquidity,          ROUND((tl.reserve0 / NULLIF(tl.reserve1, 0))::numeric, 3) AS reserve_ratio,          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tl.liquidity_provider ORDER BY tl.total_liquidity DESC) AS rn  FROM token_liquidity tl), ranked_providers AS (  SELECT liquidity_provider,          COUNT(*) AS pool_count,          AVG(log_liquidity) AS avg_log_liquidity,          SUM(CASE WHEN effective_liquidity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_effect_count,          AVG(reserve_ratio) AS avg_reserve_ratio  FROM provider_stats  WHERE rn <= 3  GROUP BY liquidity_provider) SELECT liquidity_provider,        pool_count,        ROUND(avg_log_liquidity::numeric, 4) AS truncated_avg_log,        null_effect_count,        ROUND(avg_reserve_ratio::numeric, 3) AS truncated_avg_ratio FROM ranked_providers ORDER BY avg_log_liquidity DESC
SELECT level, COUNT(*) AS total_dances, COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'Advanced' THEN 1 END) AS advanced_count FROM dances GROUP BY level

SELECT ds.dance_style_name, SUM(ds.popularity) AS total_popularity, STRING_AGG(d.dance_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.dance_name) AS dance_names FROM dance_styles ds INNER JOIN dances d ON ds.dance_style_id = d.dance_style_id GROUP BY ds.dance_style_id, ds.dance_style_name ORDER BY total_popularity DESC

SELECT "co"."operation_id", TO_CHAR("co"."start_time", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "start_fmt", TO_CHAR("co"."start_time", 'Dy') AS "day_abbr", TRUNC(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ("co"."end_time" - "co"."start_time")) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ("co"."end_time" - "co"."start_time"))) AS "duration_minutes", "cr"."cpu_usage" FROM "compression_operations" "co" INNER JOIN "compression_results" "cr" ON "co"."result_id" = "cr"."result_id" WHERE "co"."status" = 'completed' AND "cr"."cpu_usage" < 80 ORDER BY "co"."start_time"

WITH "months" ("month_id", "formatted_month") AS (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYY-MM') AS "month_id",
         TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -11), 'Day, Month DD, YYYY') AS "formatted_month"
  FROM DUAL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(months."month_id" || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1), 'YYYY-MM'),
         TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(months."month_id" || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1), 'Day, Month DD, YYYY')
  FROM "months" months
  WHERE months."month_id" < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM')
), "monthly_ops" AS (
  SELECT "m"."month_id",
         "co"."result_id",
         "cr"."method_id",
         "cm"."method_name"
  FROM "months" "m"
  LEFT JOIN "compression_operations" "co" ON TO_CHAR("co"."start_time", 'YYYY-MM') = "m"."month_id"
  LEFT JOIN "compression_results" "cr" ON "co"."result_id" = "cr"."result_id"
  LEFT JOIN "compression_methods" "cm" ON "cr"."method_id" = "cm"."method_id"
)
SELECT "month_id",
       LISTAGG("method_name", ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "method_name") AS "methods_used",
       COUNT("result_id") AS "operation_count"
FROM "monthly_ops"
GROUP BY "month_id"
ORDER BY "month_id"

SELECT datasets.dataset_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(datasets.year, '-01-01 14:30:00') AS DATETIME), '%k') AS hour_from_year, datasets.value FROM datasets WHERE datasets.year = 2023 AND datasets.value > 100000 ORDER BY datasets.value DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT d.year, COUNT(*) AS dataset_count, GROUP_CONCAT(c.country_name ORDER BY c.country_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS country_list FROM datasets d INNER JOIN countries c ON d.country_id = c.country_id GROUP BY d.year HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY d.year DESC

SELECT "al"."log_id",        TO_BLOB(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW("dqm"."metric_value")) AS "metric_blob",        NEXT_DAY("al"."access_date", 'MONDAY') AS "next_monday" FROM "access_logs" "al" INNER JOIN "datasets" "d" ON "al"."dataset_id" = "d"."dataset_id" INNER JOIN "data_quality_metrics" "dqm" ON "d"."dataset_id" = "dqm"."dataset_id" WHERE "d"."data_quality" = 'high' AND "al"."access_date" >= TO_DATE('2023-06-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY "al"."access_date"

SELECT "dqm"."metric_id", "dqm"."dataset_id", "dqm"."metric_name", CAST("dqm"."metric_value" AS NUMBER(20, 10)) AS metric_value_decimal, "dc"."category_id", "dc"."name" AS category_name, LEVEL AS category_level, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('2024-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + NUMTODSINTERVAL(1, 'DAY'), 'DDD') AS dummy_day_of_year FROM "data_quality_metrics" "dqm" LEFT JOIN "datasets" "d" ON "dqm"."dataset_id" = "d"."dataset_id" LEFT JOIN "demographic_categories" "dc" ON "dc"."parent_category_id" IS NOT NULL WHERE "dqm"."metric_name" IN ('response_rate', 'completeness_score', 'margin_of_error') AND "d"."year" BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022 CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR "dc"."category_id" = "dc"."parent_category_id" ORDER BY "dqm"."metric_id", LEVEL

SELECT "d"."device_name", "s"."status_name", NVL("s"."severity", 'Unknown') AS severity_level FROM "devices" "d" JOIN "device_statuses" "s" ON "d"."status" = "s"."status_id" WHERE "s"."status_name" IN ('Offline', 'Maintenance')

SELECT d."device_name", dt."type_name", NVL(dt."description", 'No description') AS "desc", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(d."last_update", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'IW') AS "week_number" FROM "devices" d JOIN "device_types" dt ON d."device_type" = dt."type_id" WHERE dt."manufacturer" IN ('Nest', 'Siemens') ORDER BY d."device_name"

SELECT * FROM (SELECT "a"."advertiser_name", "c"."campaign_name", "c"."budget" FROM "advertisers" "a" INNER JOIN "campaigns" "c" ON "a"."advertiser_id" = "c"."advertiser_id") PIVOT (LISTAGG("campaign_name", ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "budget" DESC) FOR "advertiser_name" IN ('Real Chemistry' AS "real_chem", 'Digital Drew' AS "digital_drew", 'Ninjapromo' AS "ninja"))

WITH "bit_xor_agg" AS (SELECT "campaign_id", "date", "impressions" FROM "campaign_performance" WHERE "campaign_id" IN (1, 2, 3)), "json_check" AS (SELECT "cp"."campaign_id", "cp"."date", "cp"."impressions", CASE WHEN JSON_EXISTS('{"campaigns": [1, 2, 3]}', '$.campaigns[*]' PASSING "cp"."campaign_id" AS "value") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "in_set" FROM "bit_xor_agg" "cp") SELECT TO_CHAR("date", 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", SUM("impressions") AS "total_impressions" FROM "json_check" WHERE "in_set" = 1 GROUP BY TO_CHAR("date", 'HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY "time"
SELECT resident_id, income, IFNULL(income, 0) AS adjusted_income FROM residents WHERE income > (SELECT AVG(income) FROM residents) ORDER BY income DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT s.resident_id, GROUP_CONCAT(r.resident_id ORDER BY r.resident_id SEPARATOR ', ') AS resident_ids, COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM residents r INNER JOIN information_sources s ON r.resident_id = s.resident_id WHERE s.src_local_media = 1 AND s.src_internet = 1 GROUP BY s.resident_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY source_count DESC

SELECT "c"."customer_id", "c"."customer_name", "o"."order_id", "o"."total_cost", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("o"."order_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "order_date_fmt", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c"."customer_id" ORDER BY "o"."total_cost" DESC) AS "cost_rank" FROM "customers" "c" INNER JOIN "orders" "o" ON "c"."customer_id" = "o"."customer_id" WHERE "o"."cancelled" = 0

WITH "product_metrics" AS (SELECT "p"."product_id", "p"."product_name", "p"."stock_level", "p"."unit_price", LN("p"."stock_level") AS "log_stock", "p"."unit_price" / NULLIF("p"."stock_level", 0) AS "price_per_stock", GREATEST("p"."unit_price", "p"."weight", NULL) AS "effective_max", LEAST("p"."unit_price", "p"."weight", NULL) AS "effective_min" FROM "products" "p" WHERE "p"."stock_level" > 0), "ranked_metrics" AS (SELECT "pm".*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TRUNC("pm"."price_per_stock", 0) ORDER BY "pm"."log_stock" DESC) AS "price_rank" FROM "product_metrics" "pm") SELECT "rm"."product_name", "rm"."log_stock", "rm"."price_per_stock", "rm"."effective_max", "rm"."effective_min", "rm"."price_rank" FROM "ranked_metrics" "rm" WHERE "rm"."price_rank" <= 3 ORDER BY "rm"."log_stock" DESC
SELECT faculty_name, appointment_date FROM faculty WHERE appointment_date = '2020-01-15'

SELECT d.degree_name, IFNULL(d.description, 'No description') AS degree_description, dl.minimum_credits, d.total_credits, d.total_credits <=> dl.minimum_credits AS credits_match FROM degrees d INNER JOIN degree_levels dl ON d.degree_level_id = dl.degree_level_id WHERE d.total_credits <=> dl.minimum_credits OR d.total_credits > 60

SELECT e.student_id, e.unit_id, e.enrollment_date, JSON_EXTRACT(e.metadata, '$.source') AS enrollment_source, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, LAG(e.enrollment_date) OVER (PARTITION BY e.student_id ORDER BY e.enrollment_date), e.enrollment_date) AS gap_days FROM unit_enrollments e WHERE e.status = 'active' ORDER BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_date

WITH enrollment_stats AS (  SELECT u.unit_id, u.title, u.credits,          COUNT(ue.enrollment_id) AS total_enrollments,          SUM(CASE WHEN ue.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_enrollments,          u.credits / COUNT(ue.enrollment_id) AS ratio,          JSON_EXTRACT(u.metadata, '$.type') AS unit_type,          DATE_FORMAT(u.last_taught_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS last_taught_month   FROM units u   LEFT JOIN unit_enrollments ue ON u.unit_id = ue.unit_id   WHERE u.is_active = 1   GROUP BY u.unit_id, u.title, u.credits, u.metadata, u.last_taught_date), ranked AS (  SELECT es.*,          COALESCE(es.unit_type, 'unknown') AS unit_type_safe,          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY es.last_taught_month ORDER BY es.total_enrollments DESC) AS rnk   FROM enrollment_stats es) SELECT r.unit_id, r.title, r.credits, r.total_enrollments,        r.active_enrollments, r.ratio,        r.unit_type_safe, r.last_taught_month FROM ranked r WHERE r.rnk <= 3 ORDER BY r.last_taught_month DESC, r.rnk
SELECT location_name || ', ' || city || ', ' || state AS full_location, contact_phone FROM locations WHERE timezone ILIKE '%America%'

SELECT l.location_name, TO_CHAR(DATE '2023-11-07', 'DD') AS day_of_month, COALESCE(SUM(v.votes), 0) AS total_votes FROM locations l INNER JOIN voting_data v ON l.location_id = v.location_id WHERE v.voting_status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY l.location_id, l.location_name ORDER BY total_votes DESC
SELECT "data_id", "time_point", "ins_pwr", "j1", "j2" FROM "sensor_data" WHERE NVL("j1", 0) != NVL("j2", 0) AND "ins_pwr" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "time_point" DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH formatted_data AS (
  SELECT sd."site_id",
         sd."sensor_type",
         TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(sd."time_point", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'Day, Month DD, YYYY HH12:MI AM') AS "formatted_time",
         sd."ins_pwr",
         sd."j1",
         sd."j2",
         CASE WHEN sd."j1" <> sd."j2" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "j1j2_mismatch_flag"
  FROM "sensor_data" sd
  WHERE sd."ins_pwr" IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT fd."site_id",
         fd."sensor_type",
         MIN(fd."ins_pwr") AS "min_power",
         MAX(fd."ins_pwr") AS "max_power",
         TRUNC(AVG(fd."ins_pwr"), 2) AS "avg_power",
         SUM(fd."j1j2_mismatch_flag") AS "mismatch_count",
         LISTAGG(fd."formatted_time", '; ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY fd."ins_pwr" DESC) AS "time_list"
  FROM formatted_data fd
  GROUP BY ROLLUP (fd."site_id", fd."sensor_type")
)
SELECT NVL(TO_CHAR(a."site_id"), 'Total') AS "site_label",
       NVL(a."sensor_type", 'All Types') AS "sensor_label",
       a."min_power",
       a."max_power",
       a."avg_power",
       a."mismatch_count",
       a."time_list"
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a."site_id" NULLS LAST, a."sensor_type" NULLS LAST
SELECT component_id, component_name, manufacturer, part_number FROM components ORDER BY component_id ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT component_name, manufacturer, TO_CHAR(last_updated, 'TMDay') AS update_day_name FROM components WHERE last_updated >= '2024-02-01' ORDER BY last_updated ASC

SELECT m.device_id, DATE(m.timestamp) AS measurement_day, ROUND(AVG(m.prms), 2) AS avg_daily_power, ROUND(AVG(m.prms) / 1000, 4) AS avg_kw FROM measurements m WHERE m.timestamp >= DATE_ADD('2024-01-15 10:30:00', INTERVAL 1 DAY_MICROSECOND) AND m.timestamp < NOW() GROUP BY m.device_id, DATE(m.timestamp) HAVING AVG(m.prms) > 1000 ORDER BY avg_daily_power DESC LIMIT 5

WITH monthly_avg AS (SELECT d.device_id, d.device_name, d.manufacturer, DATE_FORMAT(m.timestamp, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, AVG(m.prms) AS avg_prms FROM devices d INNER JOIN measurements m ON d.device_id = m.device_id WHERE d.manufacturer SOUNDS LIKE 'Simens' GROUP BY d.device_id, d.device_name, d.manufacturer, DATE_FORMAT(m.timestamp, '%Y-%m-01')), ranked AS (SELECT ma.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ma.month_start ORDER BY ma.avg_prms DESC) AS month_rank FROM monthly_avg ma) SELECT r.device_name, r.month_start, r.avg_prms, r.month_rank FROM ranked r WHERE r.month_rank <= 3 ORDER BY r.month_start, r.month_rank
SELECT image_id, label, COALESCE(label_confidence, 0.0) AS confidence FROM image_labels WHERE label_type = 'emotion' ORDER BY label_confidence DESC

SELECT c.industry, TO_CHAR(i.timestamp::timestamp, 'WW') AS week_number, COUNT(*) AS image_count FROM images i INNER JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.client_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.timestamp::timestamp) = 2023 GROUP BY c.industry, week_number HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY c.industry, week_number

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.company_id) c.company_name, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS full_name, (CURRENT_DATE - e.hire_date::date)::integer AS tenure_days FROM companies c INNER JOIN employees e ON c.company_id = e.company_id ORDER BY c.company_id, e.hire_date ASC

WITH employee_metrics AS (SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, c.company_name, e.hire_date, pm.metric_value, pm.weight, LOG(pm.metric_value) AS log_metric, WIDTH_BUCKET(pm.metric_value, 0.0, 150.0, 5) AS score_bucket, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(e.hire_date::DATE)) AS tenure_years FROM employees e INNER JOIN companies c ON e.company_id = c.company_id INNER JOIN performance_metrics pm ON e.employee_id = pm.employee_id WHERE pm.metric_name = 'Code Quality'), ranked_metrics AS (SELECT company_name, first_name, last_name, TO_CHAR(hire_date::DATE, 'Day, DD Month YYYY') AS hire_full_date, log_metric, score_bucket, tenure_years, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY score_bucket ORDER BY log_metric DESC) AS rank_in_bucket FROM employee_metrics) SELECT company_name, first_name, last_name, hire_full_date, log_metric, score_bucket, tenure_years, rank_in_bucket, CASE WHEN tenure_years / 2 > 0 THEN 'Senior' ELSE 'Junior' END AS seniority_level FROM ranked_metrics WHERE rank_in_bucket <= 3 ORDER BY score_bucket, rank_in_bucket
SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name, REPLACE(phone, ' ', '') AS clean_phone FROM employees WHERE employee_status = 'active'

SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, TO_CHAR(e.hire_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS hire_month, EXTRACT(DAY FROM e.hire_date) AS hire_day FROM employees e WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.hire_date) = 2023 ORDER BY e.hire_date

SELECT e.employee_id, SUBSTRING(e.employee_name, 1, 10) AS short_name, SQRT(POWER(e.satisfaction_level - 0.5, 2) + POWER(e.last_evaluation - 0.5, 2)) AS performance_distance, VERSION() AS db_version FROM employees e WHERE e.satisfaction_level > 0.6 AND e.last_evaluation > 0.7 ORDER BY performance_distance DESC LIMIT 10

WITH employee_project_hours AS (  SELECT e.employee_id,         e.employee_name,         SUM(ep.hours_worked) AS total_hours,         LENGTH(CAST(e.employee_name AS CHAR(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) AS name_bytes,         DATE_ADD('2024-01-01 10:00:00', INTERVAL '01:30:00' HOUR_SECOND) AS scheduled_end,         SUBSTRING(e.employee_email, LOCATE('@', e.employee_email) + 1) AS email_domain  FROM employees e  INNER JOIN employee_projects ep ON e.employee_id = ep.employee_id  GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.employee_email) SELECT ep.total_hours,        ep.name_bytes,        ep.scheduled_end,        ep.email_domain,        CAST('2024-06-15 14:30:45.123456' AS DATETIME(6)) AS precise_timestamp FROM employee_project_hours ep WHERE ep.total_hours > 100 AND ep.email_domain LIKE '%.com%' ORDER BY ep.total_hours DESC
SELECT product_name, price, brand FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.product_name, ps.size_name, ps.stock_quantity, IFNULL(pd.description, 'No description available') AS product_description FROM products p INNER JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id LEFT JOIN product_descriptions pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id WHERE ps.stock_quantity > 0 ORDER BY p.product_name, ps.size_name

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.analyst_id) a.name AS analyst_name, s.company_name, ap.position_size FROM analysts a INNER JOIN analyst_portfolio ap ON a.analyst_id = ap.analyst_id INNER JOIN stocks s ON ap.stock_id = s.stock_id ORDER BY a.analyst_id, ap.position_size DESC

WITH prediction_accuracy AS (  SELECT a.analyst_id, a.name, p.stock_id, p.predicted_price, ma.share_price,          ABS(p.predicted_price - ma.share_price) / GREATEST(ma.share_price, 1) AS error_ratio,          LOG(p.predicted_price) AS log_predicted,          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.analyst_id ORDER BY ABS(p.predicted_price - ma.share_price) ASC) AS best_pred_rank   FROM predictions p   INNER JOIN analysts a ON p.analyst_id = a.analyst_id   INNER JOIN market_analyses ma ON p.analysis_id = ma.analysis_id   WHERE p.confidence_level = 'High'), analyst_stats AS (  SELECT analyst_id, name,          AVG(error_ratio) AS avg_error,          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE error_ratio < 0.1) AS accurate_predictions,          REGEXP_REPLACE(name, '([A-Z])[a-z]+ [A-Z]', '\1. ', 'g') AS initials   FROM prediction_accuracy   WHERE best_pred_rank <= 3   GROUP BY analyst_id, name) SELECT analyst_id, name, initials,        ROUND(avg_error::numeric, 4) AS avg_error_rounded,        accurate_predictions,        GREATEST(avg_error, NULL) AS null_test FROM analyst_stats ORDER BY avg_error ASC
SELECT instrument_name, sector, industry FROM instruments WHERE instrument_name LIKE '%F%'

SELECT i.instrument_name, i.sector, IFNULL(e.exchange_name, 'Unknown') AS exchange_name, m.volume FROM instruments i INNER JOIN market_data m ON i.instrument_id = m.instrument_id LEFT JOIN exchanges e ON i.exchange = e.exchange_id WHERE m.volume > 10000000 ORDER BY m.volume DESC

SELECT c.client_id, IFNULL(AVG(q.query_duration), 0) AS avg_duration, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(STR_TO_DATE(q.query_date_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')), '%W, %M %d, %Y') AS last_query_date FROM clients c LEFT JOIN queries q ON c.client_id = q.client_id GROUP BY c.client_id HAVING AVG(q.query_duration) > 0.3

WITH monthly_performance AS (  SELECT i.instrument_id, i.instrument_name, e.exchange_name, e.exchange_id,         md.close, md.event_timestamp,         DATE_FORMAT(md.event_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month_key,         LOG(md.close) AS log_close_ln,         GREATEST(md.close, NULL, md.open) AS effective_price,         TRUNCATE(md.close / 2, 4) AS half_close  FROM instruments i  INNER JOIN exchanges e ON i.exchange_id = e.exchange_id  INNER JOIN market_data md ON i.instrument_id = md.instrument_id  WHERE md.event_timestamp >= DATE_SUB('2024-06-01', INTERVAL 6 MONTH)), ranked AS (  SELECT mp.*,         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mp.exchange_id, mp.month_key ORDER BY mp.log_close_ln DESC) AS price_rank  FROM monthly_performance mp)SELECT r.exchange_name, r.month_key, r.instrument_name, r.close, r.log_close_ln, r.effective_price, r.half_close, r.price_rank FROM ranked r WHERE r.price_rank <= 3 ORDER BY r.exchange_name, r.month_key, r.price_rank
SELECT "trader_name" || ' - ' || "email" AS trader_info, "role" FROM "traders" WHERE "email" ILIKE '%@%'

SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name, TO_CHAR(md.date::date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, AVG(md.close) AS avg_close FROM stocks s INNER JOIN market_data md ON s.stock_id = md.stock_id WHERE s.sector = 'Technology' AND s.market_cap > 500000000000.0 GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.symbol, s.company_name, month ORDER BY month, s.symbol

SELECT fr.ticker, fr.fiscal_period, c.cash_flow_from_oper_act, c.net_change_in_cash, LAG(c.cash_flow_from_oper_act) OVER (PARTITION BY fr.ticker ORDER BY fr.report_date) AS prev_oper_cash, CAST(c.cash_flow_from_oper_act / NULLIF(c.net_change_in_cash, 0) AS SIGNED) AS cash_efficiency_ratio, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(fr.report_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS iso_format FROM financial_reports fr INNER JOIN cash_flow_statement c ON fr.report_id = c.report_id WHERE c.net_change_in_cash > 0 ORDER BY fr.ticker, fr.report_date

WITH efficiency_metrics AS (  SELECT fr.ticker,         fr.fiscal_period,         inc.revenue,         inc.net_income,         inc.operating_income,         inc.sga_expense,         GREATEST(inc.net_income / inc.revenue, NULL) AS profit_margin,         inc.revenue / inc.sga_expense AS revenue_per_sga,         CAST(inc.revenue AS SIGNED) / CAST(inc.sga_expense AS SIGNED) AS int_div_example  FROM financial_reports fr  INNER JOIN income_statement inc ON fr.report_id = inc.report_id  WHERE fr.status = 'published'), ranked AS (  SELECT em.*,         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY em.fiscal_period ORDER BY em.revenue DESC) AS rank_in_period,         DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE('2023-04-01', '%Y-%m-%d'), '%W, %M %d, %Y') AS format_test  FROM efficiency_metrics em) SELECT r.ticker,       r.fiscal_period,       r.revenue,       r.profit_margin,       r.revenue_per_sga,       r.int_div_example,       r.rank_in_period,       r.format_test FROM ranked r WHERE r.rank_in_period <= 3 ORDER BY r.fiscal_period, r.rank_in_period

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS activity_month, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, AVG(distance) AS avg_distance FROM activities WHERE distance > 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY activity_month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%m') AS activity_month, AVG(a.distance) AS avg_distance FROM activities a INNER JOIN devices d ON a.device_id = d.device_id WHERE a.is_manual = 0 GROUP BY activity_month HAVING AVG(a.distance) > 5 ORDER BY activity_month

SELECT m.meal_id, m.meal_name, JSON_EXTRACT(m.tags_json, '$[0]') AS first_tag, m.average_rating FROM meals m WHERE 'vegan' MEMBER OF (m.tags_json) AND m.average_rating > 4.0 ORDER BY m.average_rating DESC

WITH meal_analysis AS (SELECT m.meal_id, m.meal_name, m.calories, m.fat, m.carbohydrates, m.protein, m.base_price, m.popularity_score, LOG(m.calories) AS log_calories, TRUNCATE(m.fat / m.protein, 2) AS fat_protein_ratio, GREATEST(m.popularity_score, (SELECT AVG(m2.popularity_score) FROM meals m2 WHERE m2.category_id = m.category_id), NULL) AS adjusted_score, m.tags_json FROM meals m WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(m.tags_json, '"vegan"')), ordered_meals AS (SELECT * FROM meal_analysis ORDER BY popularity_score DESC), aggregated AS (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(ma.meal_name) AS top_meals_json, SUM(ma.log_calories) AS total_log_calories, AVG(ma.fat_protein_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(IF(ma.adjusted_score IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS null_score_count FROM ordered_meals ma) SELECT * FROM aggregated
SELECT inventory_id, product_id, stock_level, DATE_FORMAT(last_updated, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS formatted_update FROM inventory WHERE stock_level < 30 ORDER BY stock_level ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS resolution_month, u.user_name AS resolver_name, f.feedback_text, f.resolution_status FROM feedback f INNER JOIN users u ON f.resolved_by = u.user_id WHERE f.resolution_status = 'Resolved' ORDER BY resolution_month DESC, u.user_name

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.department) r.department, r.researcher_name, a.algorithm_name, pm.score AS max_score, (a.json_metadata->>'paper_ref')::TEXT AS paper_reference FROM researchers r INNER JOIN algorithms a ON r.researcher_id = a.created_by INNER JOIN performance_metrics pm ON a.algorithm_id = pm.algorithm_id WHERE pm.score > 0 ORDER BY r.department, pm.score DESC

WITH algorithm_rankings AS (
  SELECT a.algorithm_id, a.algorithm_name, pm.score, pm.evaluation_date,
         LOG(pm.training_time) AS log_training_time,
         TRUNC(pm.training_time / pm.number_of_episodes, 2) AS time_per_episode,
         GREATEST(pm.score, (SELECT AVG(pm2.score) FROM "performance_metrics" pm2 WHERE pm2.algorithm_id = pm.algorithm_id), NULL) AS effective_score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.algorithm_id ORDER BY pm.evaluation_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM "algorithms" a
  INNER JOIN "performance_metrics" pm ON a.algorithm_id = pm.algorithm_id
  WHERE pm.number_of_episodes > 0

SELECT project_name, status, start_date FROM projects ORDER BY start_date ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, COUNT(m.milestone_id) AS milestone_count, GROUP_CONCAT(m.milestone_number ORDER BY m.milestone_number SEPARATOR ', ') AS milestone_numbers FROM projects p INNER JOIN milestones m ON p.project_id = m.project_id WHERE p.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name HAVING COUNT(m.milestone_id) >= 1 ORDER BY milestone_count DESC

SELECT "tr"."neighborhood_id", DECODE("tr"."prop_tax_exempt", 1, 'Yes', 'No') AS "is_exempt", REGEXP_SUBSTR("tr"."tax_incentives", '[^ ]+', 1, 1) AS "first_incentive_word", AVG("tr"."tax_rate") AS "avg_tax_rate" FROM "tax_rates" "tr" WHERE "tr"."tax_incentives" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "tr"."neighborhood_id", "tr"."prop_tax_exempt", REGEXP_SUBSTR("tr"."tax_incentives", '[^ ]+', 1, 1) HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY "avg_tax_rate" DESC

WITH base_stats AS (
  SELECT n."neighborhood_id", n."name", n."region", n."population", n."area_sq_mi",
         LN(n."population" / n."area_sq_mi") AS log_pop_density,
         ROUND(n."median_income" / 12, 2) AS monthly_income,
         GREATEST(n."median_house_value", (SELECT AVG(r."median_house_price") FROM "real_estate_data" r WHERE r."neighborhood_id" = n."neighborhood_id"), NULL) AS effective_home_value
  FROM "neighborhoods" n
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT b."neighborhood_id", b."name", b."region", b."population", b."area_sq_mi",
         b.log_pop_density,
         b.monthly_income,
         b.effective_home_value,
         DECODE(SIGN(b.effective_home_value - 700000), 1, 'High', 0, 'Medium', -1, 'Low') AS price_tier,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b."region" ORDER BY b.log_pop_density DESC) AS reg_rank
  FROM base_stats b
)
SELECT r."region", r."name", r.log_pop_density, r.monthly_income, r.price_tier, r.reg_rank
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.reg_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r."region", r.reg_rank
SELECT experiment_name, DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS formatted_start_date FROM experiments WHERE start_date >= '2023-01-01' AND start_date < '2024-01-01' AND status = 'active'
SELECT e.experiment_name, DATE_FORMAT(e.start_date, '%Y-%m') AS start_month, IFNULL(e.notes, 'No notes') AS notes FROM experiments e WHERE e.status = 'active' ORDER BY start_month

SELECT "y"."year_name", TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR("ra"."evangelical_lutheran", '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) AS "pct_evangelical", NVL(TO_CHAR(ROUND( (TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR("ra"."evangelical_lutheran", '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) - LAG(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR("ra"."evangelical_lutheran", '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?'))) OVER (ORDER BY "y"."year_name")) / LAG(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR("ra"."evangelical_lutheran", '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?'))) OVER (ORDER BY "y"."year_name") * 100, 2), '999.99'), 'N/A') AS "pct_change" FROM "religious_affiliations" "ra" INNER JOIN "years" "y" ON "ra"."year" = "y"."year_id" ORDER BY "y"."year_name"
SELECT "user_name", "last_login" FROM (SELECT "user_name", "last_login" FROM "users" ORDER BY "last_login" DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT sd.location_id,
         DATE_FORMAT(sd.date, '%W, %M %d, %Y') AS full_date,
         sd.total_sales,
         JSON_VALUE(r.content, '$.meta.tags[0]') AS first_tag,
         IF(sd.total_sales > 1000, 'high', 'low') AS sales_category
  FROM sales_data sd
  INNER JOIN reports r ON sd.location_id = r.location_id
  WHERE r.report_type = 'JSON Test'
),
location_summary AS (
  SELECT ws.location_id, l.name,
         GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ws.first_tag ORDER BY ws.first_tag SEPARATOR ' | ') AS tags_used,
         SUM(ws.total_sales) AS total_sales,
         SUM(IF(ws.sales_category = 'high', 1, 0)) AS high_sales_count
  FROM weekly_sales ws
  INNER JOIN locations l ON ws.location_id = l.location_id
  GROUP BY ws.location_id, l.name
)
SELECT name, tags_used, total_sales, high_sales_count
FROM location_summary
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT l.name, DATE_FORMAT(s.date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(s.total_sales) AS total_sales FROM locations l INNER JOIN sales_data s ON l.location_id = s.location_id INNER JOIN categories c ON l.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = _UTF8'Bookstore' AND s.total_sales > 0 GROUP BY l.location_id, l.name, month ORDER BY month, total_sales DESC

SELECT s.store_name, s.store_city, TO_CHAR(s.store_open_date::timestamp, 'MM') AS open_month, s.store_nbr % 2 AS nbr_parity FROM stores s WHERE s.store_nbr % 2 = 0 AND TO_CHAR(s.store_open_date::timestamp, 'MM')::integer IN (SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(1, 12, 2)) ORDER BY s.store_nbr

WITH date_parsed AS (
  SELECT sd.*,
         TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(sd.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM') AS sale_month,
         TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(sd.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'Day') AS sale_day_name
  FROM sales_data sd
),
discount_analysis AS (
  SELECT dp.*,
         LEAST(dp.total_discount, dp.sales * 0.5) AS capped_discount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dp.store_nbr, dp.sale_month ORDER BY dp.sales DESC) AS rank_in_store_month
  FROM date_parsed dp
  WHERE dp.return_flag = False
),
store_ranked AS (
  SELECT da.*,
         AVG(da.sales) OVER (PARTITION BY da.store_nbr) AS avg_store_sales,
         MAX(da.capped_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.family) AS max_family_capped_discount
  FROM discount_analysis da
)
SELECT sr.store_nbr,
       sr.family,
       sr.sale_date,
       sr.sales,
       sr.capped_discount,
       sr.avg_store_sales,
       sr.max_family_capped_discount,
       sr.rank_in_store_month,
       CASE
          WHEN sr.sale_day_name = 'Sunday' THEN 'Weekend'
          WHEN sr.sale_day_name = 'Saturday' THEN 'Weekend'
          ELSE 'Weekday'
       END AS day_type,
       sr.sale_month
FROM store_ranked sr
WHERE sr.rank_in_store_month <= 3
  AND (EXTRACT(DOW FROM TO_DATE(sr.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::INTEGER % 2) = 0
ORDER BY sr.store_nbr, sr.rank_in_store_month
SELECT customer_name, contact_email FROM customers WHERE contact_email LIKE '%@example.com' ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS same_month_orders FROM orders o WHERE DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-01') = DATE_FORMAT(o.stock_date, '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY order_month

SELECT "c"."condition_name", "ct"."type_name", VARIANCE("m"."value") AS "value_variance", AVG("m"."value") AS "mean_value", DECODE(SIGN(AVG("m"."value") - 50), 1, 'High Mean', -1, 'Low Mean', 'Mid Mean') AS "mean_category", COUNT(DISTINCT "m"."device_id") AS "device_count" FROM "conditions" "c" INNER JOIN "condition_types" "ct" ON "c"."type_id" = "ct"."type_id" INNER JOIN "measurements" "m" ON "c"."condition_id" = "m"."condition_id" WHERE "m"."value" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c"."condition_name", "ct"."type_name" HAVING VARIANCE("m"."value") > 5 AND COUNT("m"."measurement_id") > 2

SELECT UNIQUE "d"."device_id", "d"."model_number", VARIANCE("m"."value") AS "measurement_variance", REGR_AVGY("m"."value", "p"."typical_value") AS "regr_avg_y", TRUNC(REGR_SLOPE("m"."value", "p"."typical_value"), 4) AS "regr_slope" FROM "devices" "d" INNER JOIN "measurements" "m" ON "d"."device_id" = "m"."device_id" INNER JOIN "parameters" "p" ON "m"."parameter_id" = "p"."parameter_id" WHERE LENGTH("d"."model_number") > 5 GROUP BY "d"."device_id", "d"."model_number" HAVING VARIANCE("m"."value") > 1 AND REGR_AVGY("m"."value", "p"."typical_value") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "measurement_variance" DESC
SELECT name, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS formatted_date FROM simulations WHERE status = 'completed'

SELECT TO_CHAR(sim.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, sim.name, COUNT(tsd.time_series_id) AS data_points FROM simulations sim INNER JOIN time_series_data tsd ON sim.simulation_id = tsd.simulation_id WHERE sim.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month, sim.name ORDER BY month, data_points DESC

SELECT u.user_id, RPAD(u.username, 20, '.') AS padded_username, DATE_FORMAT(u.join_date, '%W, %M %d, %Y') AS formatted_join_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content c WHERE c.user_id = u.user_id AND c.post_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS recent_posts_count FROM users u WHERE u.account_status = 'active' ORDER BY recent_posts_count DESC

WITH user_activity AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.content_id) AS content_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.user_id) AS unique_likers, BIT_OR(cl.user_id) AS liker_bitmask, MOD(COUNT(DISTINCT cl.user_id), 10) AS liker_mod, GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.content_id), COUNT(DISTINCT cl.user_id), NULL) AS max_metric FROM content c LEFT JOIN content_likes cl ON c.content_id = cl.content_id GROUP BY c.user_id), user_stats AS (SELECT ua.user_id, u.username, ua.content_count, ua.unique_likers, ua.liker_mod, ua.max_metric, VAR_POP(ua.content_count) OVER () AS overall_content_var, VAR_POP(ua.unique_likers) OVER () AS overall_liker_var FROM user_activity ua INNER JOIN users u ON ua.user_id = u.user_id) SELECT us.username, us.content_count, us.unique_likers, us.liker_mod, us.overall_content_var, us.overall_liker_var, IF(us.max_metric IS NULL, 'null_max', 'non_null_max') AS max_status FROM user_stats us ORDER BY us.content_count DESC
SELECT "package_name", "heaviness_score", TO_CHAR("last_updated", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "formatted_date" FROM "packages" WHERE "heaviness_score" > 4.0

SELECT DISTINCT p."package_name", NVL(p."heaviness_score", 0) AS score FROM "packages" p INNER JOIN "dependencies" d ON p."package_id" = d."child_package_id" WHERE p."last_updated" > TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY p."package_name"
SELECT r.release_id, r.release_name, DATE_ADD(r.release_date, INTERVAL '10:30' MINUTE_SECOND) AS adjusted_release_date FROM releases r WHERE r.release_id = 1

WITH release_analysis AS (  SELECT r.product_id,          r.release_id,          r.release_date,          r.deadline,          DATE_ADD(r.deadline, INTERVAL '30:00' MINUTE_SECOND) AS extended_deadline,          NULL AS parsed_version,          r.release_name AS geostd8_name,          COUNT(DISTINCT ih.issue_id, ih.changed_by) AS unique_issue_changers   FROM releases r   LEFT JOIN issue_history ih ON r.release_id = ih.issue_id   WHERE r.release_date >= DATE_ADD('2023-04-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)   GROUP BY r.product_id, r.release_id, r.release_date, r.deadline, r.description), ranked_releases AS (  SELECT ra.*,         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.product_id ORDER BY ra.extended_deadline DESC) AS deadline_rank,         LEAD(ra.extended_deadline) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.product_id ORDER BY ra.release_date) AS next_extended_deadline   FROM release_analysis ra) SELECT rr.product_id,        rr.release_id,        rr.release_date,        rr.extended_deadline,        rr.unique_issue_changers,        rr.deadline_rank,        CASE WHEN rr.next_extended_deadline IS NOT NULL              THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rr.extended_deadline, rr.next_extended_deadline)         ELSE 0 END AS gap_minutes FROM ranked_releases rr WHERE rr.deadline_rank <= 2 ORDER BY rr.product_id, rr.deadline_rank
SELECT "user_id", "user_name", "email", NVL("phone_number", 'N/A') AS "phone_number" FROM "users" WHERE "status" = 'active' ORDER BY "created_date"

SELECT TO_CHAR(tc."created_date", 'YYYY-MM') AS "creation_month", m."module_name", COUNT(tc."test_case_id") AS "case_count" FROM "test_cases" tc INNER JOIN "modules" m ON tc."module_id" = m."module_id" GROUP BY TO_CHAR(tc."created_date", 'YYYY-MM'), m."module_name" ORDER BY "creation_month", "case_count" DESC

SELECT sub.team_name, sub.player_name, sub.birth_date, sub.total_yards FROM (SELECT t.team_name, CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name) AS player_name, DATE_FORMAT(p.dob, '%Y-%m-%d') AS birth_date, ss.total_yards, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.team_id ORDER BY ss.total_yards DESC) AS rn FROM players p INNER JOIN teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id INNER JOIN season_stats ss ON p.player_id = ss.player_id AND ss.year = 2023) sub WHERE sub.rn <= 3 ORDER BY sub.team_name, sub.rn

WITH player_efficiency AS (  SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.salary,          p.weight, p.height,          LOG(p.salary) AS log_salary,          TRUNCATE(p.salary / IFNULL(rs.average, 1), 2) AS salary_per_yard,          GREATEST(p.salary, (           SELECT AVG(p2.salary) FROM players p2 WHERE p2.team_id = p.team_id         ), NULL) AS effective_salary   FROM players p   LEFT JOIN (    SELECT player_id, AVG(average) AS average    FROM rushing_stats    GROUP BY player_id   ) rs ON p.player_id = rs.player_id), ranked AS (  SELECT pe.*, t.team_name,          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.team_id ORDER BY pe.log_salary DESC) AS rn   FROM player_efficiency pe   INNER JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM players WHERE player_id = pe.player_id LIMIT 1)) SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count,        TRUNCATE(AVG(log_salary), 4) AS avg_log_salary,        TRUNCATE(AVG(salary_per_yard), 2) AS avg_salary_per_yard,        SUM(IF(effective_salary IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS null_salary_count FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY avg_log_salary DESC
SELECT "username", TO_CHAR("created_at", 'HH') AS "creation_hour" FROM "users" WHERE "is_active" = 1

SELECT "r"."region_name", "tp"."period_name", (SYSDATE - "tp"."start_date") AS days_since_start FROM "time_periods" "tp" INNER JOIN "category_statistics" "cs" ON "tp"."time_period_id" = "cs"."time_period_id" INNER JOIN "regions" "r" ON "cs"."region_id" = "r"."region_id" WHERE "tp"."start_date" >= TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND "cs"."sample_size" > 500 GROUP BY "r"."region_name", "tp"."period_name", "tp"."start_date" ORDER BY days_since_start DESC

SELECT "s"."sector_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "st"."stock_id") AS "num_stocks", AVG("f"."revenue") AS "avg_revenue", MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."net_income" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "all_profitable" FROM "sectors" "s" INNER JOIN "stocks" "st" ON "s"."sector_id" = "st"."sector_id" INNER JOIN "financials" "f" ON "st"."stock_id" = "f"."stock_id" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("f"."fiscal_year" || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2023 GROUP BY "s"."sector_name" HAVING MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."net_income" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 ORDER BY "avg_revenue" DESC

WITH date_range (price_date) AS ( SELECT TO_DATE('2024-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS price_date FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT dr.price_date + 1 FROM date_range dr WHERE dr.price_date < TO_DATE('2024-03-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ), monthly_aggregates AS ( SELECT sp."stock_id", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(sp."price_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM') AS trade_month, AVG(sp."close") AS avg_close, SUM(sp."volume") AS total_volume, LISTAGG(TO_CHAR(sp."close", '999.99'), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TO_DATE(sp."price_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS close_prices FROM "stock_prices" sp GROUP BY sp."stock_id", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(sp."price_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM') ), ranked_stocks AS ( SELECT ma."stock_id", ma.trade_month, ma.avg_close, ma.total_volume, ma.close_prices, GREATEST(ma.avg_close, (SELECT AVG(sp2."close") FROM "stock_prices" sp2 WHERE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(sp2."price_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM') = ma.trade_month)) AS effective_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ma.trade_month ORDER BY ma.total_volume DESC) AS volume_rank FROM monthly_aggregates ma ) SELECT rs.trade_month, rs."stock_id", rs.avg_close, rs.total_volume, rs.close_prices, rs.effective_avg, rs.volume_rank FROM ranked_stocks rs WHERE rs.volume_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.trade_month, rs.volume_rank
SELECT file_path || ' (' || file_size || ' MB)' AS file_info FROM data_files WHERE file_type ILIKE 'csv' AND is_active = true

SELECT c.country_name, STRING_AGG(sd.method, ', ' ORDER BY sd.method) AS methods_used FROM countries c INNER JOIN suicide_data sd ON c.country_id = sd.country_id INNER JOIN sex s ON sd.sex = s.sex_id WHERE s.sex_name = 'male' AND sd.suicides_no > 0 GROUP BY c.country_name
SELECT incident_id, crime_code_description, date_occurred FROM incidents WHERE officer_id = 1 AND incident_status = 'active' ORDER BY date_occurred DESC LIMIT 10

WITH area_crime_stats AS (
  SELECT a.area_id, a.area_name, DATE(i.date_occurred) AS truncated_date,
    CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(i.mo_codes) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.mo_codes, '$.codes[0]')) ELSE NULL END AS first_mo_code,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.crime_code_description, '[A-Z]+') AS code_alpha_part
  FROM incidents i
  INNER JOIN areas a ON i.area_id = a.area_id
  WHERE i.victim_age > 0
)
SELECT acs.area_name, acs.truncated_date, acs.first_mo_code, acs.code_alpha_part, 'Active' AS status_flag
FROM area_crime_stats acs
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM incidents i2
  WHERE i2.area_id = acs.area_id
  AND i2.crime_code IN (SELECT crime_code FROM crime_codes WHERE severity = 'felony')
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM incidents i3
  INNER JOIN areas a2 ON i3.area_id = a2.area_id
  WHERE i3.area_id = acs.area_id
  AND i3.incident_status = 'closed'
  AND DATE(i3.date_occurred) = acs.truncated_date
  AND CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(i3.mo_codes) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i3.mo_codes, '$.codes[0]')) ELSE NULL END = acs.first_mo_code
  AND REGEXP_SUBSTR(i3.crime_code_description, '[A-Z]+') = acs.code_alpha_part
)
SELECT incident_id, description, IF(end_time IS NOT NULL, 'Resolved', 'Ongoing') AS status_label FROM incidents WHERE severity > 1

SELECT i.incident_id, i.severity, l.city, IFNULL(i.end_time, 'ongoing') AS end_status, i.priority_code FROM incidents i INNER JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.location_id WHERE i.severity >= 3 ORDER BY i.severity DESC

SELECT u."university_id", u."university_name", u."location_code", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('2024-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'yyyy') AS "rank_year", ar."ar_score", er."er_score", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u."location_code" ORDER BY (NVL(ar."ar_score", 0) + NVL(er."er_score", 0)) DESC) AS "composite_rank" FROM "universities" u INNER JOIN "rankings" r ON u."university_id" = r."university_id" INNER JOIN "academic_reputation" ar ON r."ranking_id" = ar."ranking_id" INNER JOIN "employer_reputation" er ON r."ranking_id" = er."ranking_id" WHERE r."year" = 2024 AND r."score_scaled" > 90

WITH university_metrics AS ( SELECT "u"."university_id", "u"."university_name", "u"."country", "u"."university_type", "u"."established_year", "r"."ranking_id", "r"."score_scaled", "r"."rank", "r"."year", "ar"."ar_score", "er"."er_score", "fsr"."fsr_score", "cpf"."cpf_score", "ifr"."ifr_score", "isr"."isr_score", "irn"."irn_score", "ger"."ger_score", (NVL("ar"."ar_score", 0) + NVL("er"."er_score", 0) + NVL("fsr"."fsr_score", 0) + NVL("cpf"."cpf_score", 0) + NVL("ifr"."ifr_score", 0) + NVL("isr"."isr_score", 0) + NVL("irn"."irn_score", 0) + NVL("ger"."ger_score", 0)) AS "total_score", GREATEST("ar"."ar_score", "er"."er_score", "fsr"."fsr_score", "cpf"."cpf_score", "ifr"."ifr_score", "isr"."isr_score", "irn"."irn_score", "ger"."ger_score", NULL) AS "max_metric_score" FROM "universities" "u" INNER JOIN "rankings" "r" ON "u"."university_id" = "r"."university_id" LEFT JOIN "academic_reputation" "ar" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "ar"."ranking_id" LEFT JOIN "employer_reputation" "er" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "er"."ranking_id" LEFT JOIN "faculty_student_ratio" "fsr" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "fsr"."ranking_id" LEFT JOIN "citations_per_faculty" "cpf" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "cpf"."ranking_id" LEFT JOIN "international_faculty_ratio" "ifr" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "ifr"."ranking_id" LEFT JOIN "international_student_ratio" "isr" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "isr"."ranking_id" LEFT JOIN "international_research_network" "irn" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "irn"."ranking_id" LEFT JOIN "gender_enrollment_ratio" "ger" ON "r"."ranking_id" = "ger"."ranking_id" WHERE "r"."year" = 2024 ), type_summary AS ( SELECT "university_type", "country", COUNT(DISTINCT "university_id") AS "university_count", ROUND(AVG("total_score"), 2) AS "avg_total_score", MAX("total_score") AS "max_total_score", MIN("total_score") AS "min_total_score", ROUND(AVG("max_metric_score"), 2) AS "avg_max_metric", 0 AS "binary_univ_count_ones", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "university_type" ORDER BY AVG("total_score") DESC) AS "type_rank" FROM university_metrics GROUP BY "university_type", "country" ) SELECT "university_type", "country", "university_count", "avg_total_score", "max_total_score", "min_total_score", "avg_max_metric", "binary_univ_count_ones", "type_rank", ("avg_total_score" / GREATEST("avg_max_metric", 1)) AS "efficiency_ratio" FROM type_summary WHERE "type_rank" <= 3 ORDER BY "university_type", "type_rank"

SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.*, u1."name" AS sender_name, u2."name" AS receiver_name FROM "communications" c LEFT JOIN "users" u1 ON c."sender_id" = u1."user_id" LEFT JOIN "users" u2 ON c."receiver_id" = u2."user_id" ORDER BY c."sent_at" DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT TO_CHAR(p."start_date", 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", NVL2(p."approval_due_date", 'Has Deadline', 'No Deadline') AS "deadline_status", COUNT(p."program_id") AS "program_count" FROM "programs" p GROUP BY TO_CHAR(p."start_date", 'YYYY-MM'), NVL2(p."approval_due_date", 'Has Deadline', 'No Deadline') ORDER BY "month", "deadline_status"

SELECT "p"."player_id", "p"."username", TRUNC("p"."last_login_date", 'MM') AS "login_month" FROM "players" "p" WHERE LENGTH("p"."username") - LENGTH(REPLACE("p"."username", 'a', '')) <= 2 AND "p"."username" LIKE '%a%'

SELECT * FROM (  SELECT "p"."status", "at"."type_name", "dm"."damage_dealt", "p"."player_id",         REGEXP_COUNT(TO_CHAR("p"."player_id", 'XXXXXXXX'), '1') AS "bit_count_id"   FROM "damage_metrics" "dm"   INNER JOIN "players" "p" ON "dm"."player_id" = "p"."player_id"   INNER JOIN "attack_types" "at" ON "dm"."attack_type_id" = "at"."type_id"   WHERE "p"."status" = 'active') PIVOT (  AVG("damage_dealt") AS "avg_damage",  SUM("bit_count_id") AS "total_bit_count"  FOR "type_name" IN ('Melee Strike' AS "melee", 'Fireball' AS "fireball", 'Heal' AS "heal")) ORDER BY "status"
SELECT COUNT(*) AS game_count, GROUP_CONCAT(g.title ORDER BY g.title SEPARATOR ', ') AS game_titles FROM games g WHERE g.platform_id = 1

SELECT g.genre_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.platform_name ORDER BY p.platform_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS platforms, COUNT(gp.game_platform_id) AS platform_count FROM games g INNER JOIN game_platforms gp ON g.game_id = gp.game_id INNER JOIN platforms p ON gp.platform_id = p.platform_id WHERE g.popularity > 85 GROUP BY g.genre_id HAVING platform_count >= 2 ORDER BY platform_count DESC

SELECT "ag"."age_range", "voter_details"."voter_id", "voter_details"."reg_month_diff" FROM (SELECT "v"."voter_id", "v"."age_group_id", "v"."voter_registration_date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "v"."age_group_id" ORDER BY "v"."voter_registration_date") AS "rn", ROUND(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, "v"."voter_registration_date")) AS "reg_month_diff" FROM "voters" "v" WHERE "v"."is_active" = 1) "voter_details" INNER JOIN "age_groups" "ag" ON "voter_details"."age_group_id" = "ag"."age_group_id" WHERE "voter_details"."rn" <= 5 ORDER BY TO_CHAR("ag"."age_range"), "voter_details"."reg_month_diff" DESC

SELECT "response_id", "voter_id", "response_date", "response_status" FROM (SELECT "response_id", "voter_id", "response_date", "response_status" FROM "survey_responses" ORDER BY "response_date" DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

WITH station_efficiency AS (
  SELECT ws.station_id, ws.station_name,
         LOG(ws.elevation) AS log_elevation,
         GREATEST(ws.elevation, (
           SELECT AVG(ws2.elevation) FROM weather_stations ws2 WHERE ws2.active_status = 1
         ), NULL) AS effective_elevation,
         DATE_FORMAT(ws.installation_date, '%W, %M %d, %Y') AS formatted_install
  FROM weather_stations ws
  WHERE ws.active_status = 1
),
ranked_stations AS (
  SELECT se.*,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(se.formatted_install, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY se.log_elevation DESC) AS elev_rank,
         se.effective_elevation DIV 2 AS half_effective_elev,
         se.log_elevation DIV 10 AS log_category
  FROM station_efficiency se
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ranked_stations.formatted_install, '%Y-%m') AS install_month,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count,
       AVG(ranked_stations.log_elevation) AS avg_log_elevation,
       SUM(IF(ranked_stations.effective_elevation IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS null_elev_count,
       AVG(ranked_stations.half_effective_elev) AS avg_half_elev
FROM ranked_stations
WHERE ranked_stations.elev_rank <= 3
GROUP BY install_month
ORDER BY install_month DESC

SELECT ws.station_name, COUNT(du.upload_id) AS total_uploads, IF(SUM(du.file_size) > 5, 'High Volume', 'Normal') AS upload_volume_category, GROUP_CONCAT(du.upload_method ORDER BY du.upload_method SEPARATOR ', ') AS methods_used FROM weather_stations ws INNER JOIN data_uploads du ON ws.station_id = du.station_id WHERE du.upload_status = 'successful' GROUP BY ws.station_id, ws.station_name ORDER BY total_uploads DESC

SELECT ranked.type_name, ranked.plan_name, ranked.high_rating_count, ranked.cpu_rank FROM (SELECT pt.type_name, p.plan_name, COUNT(pr.review_id) FILTER (WHERE pr.rating >= 4) AS high_rating_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.type_name ORDER BY (p.metadata->'limits'->>'cpu')::TEXT DESC NULLS LAST) AS cpu_rank FROM plans p INNER JOIN plan_types pt ON p.type_id = pt.type_id LEFT JOIN plan_reviews pr ON p.plan_id = pr.plan_id GROUP BY pt.type_name, p.plan_name, p.metadata) ranked WHERE ranked.cpu_rank <= 3

WITH plan_data AS (  SELECT p.plan_id, p.plan_name, p.cost, p.type_id, p.metadata,          TO_CHAR((p.metadata->>'created_at')::DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS metadata_date,          REGEXP_REPLACE(p.plan_name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '') AS clean_name   FROM plans p   WHERE p.metadata IS NOT NULL), ranked_plans AS (  SELECT pd.plan_id, pd.plan_name, pd.cost, pd.type_id,          pd.metadata_date, pd.clean_name,          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (            PARTITION BY pd.type_id             ORDER BY pd.cost DESC, pd.clean_name           ) AS rn   FROM plan_data pd) SELECT rp.plan_id, rp.plan_name, rp.cost,        pt.type_name,        rp.metadata_date,        rp.clean_name,        rp.rn,        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rp.rn <= 3) OVER (PARTITION BY rp.type_id) AS top3_count FROM ranked_plans rp INNER JOIN plan_types pt ON rp.type_id = pt.type_id WHERE rp.rn <= 5 ORDER BY rp.type_id, rp.rn
